fold_policy: sort unique source_entity_key by SHA256(seed|entity), assign round-robin to five folds; unseen drug identities, not unseen chemical families or cell contexts
field_fit_policy: one-hot response ridge, common training-only landmark features; concatenate field targets then split equivalent least-squares outputs; no tuning

random_field.policy: SHA256 seeded normal unit vector per typed field:value, sum only supplied fields then L2; same entity vector across views

baseline_vocab_policy: source-only for decoding; gallery-only for retrieval; unseen categorical fields ignored, not target-fitted

condition_retrieval.note: fixed cell-line restriction is supplied; this tests drug-dose identification, not cell-line retention

tie_policy: exact cosine-score ties; uniform tie-order expected reciprocal rank and hit@1; no atomic-ID tie breaking for metrics
scope: single-study original-name fidelity and closed-inventory cross-view retrieval; not response prediction, no chemical-family or unseen-context claim
score_inspection_before_contract: six-encoder response prediction already observed; no E01 results computed before this contract
anonymous_status: not included in this source-name run; remains separately required
